quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the center of a two-lane, two-directional highway and overtaking and passing another vehicle proceeding in the same direction, unless such left side is clearly visible and is free of oncoming traffic for a sufficient distance ahead to permit such overtaking and passing to be completely made without interfering with the safe operation of any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction or any vehicle overtaken.

activation.condition: Motor vehicle driver on a two-lane, two-directional highway overtakes and passes another vehicle proceeding in the same direction.

obligation.description: Do not drive left of center while overtaking and passing unless every stated visibility, traffic, completion and noninterference condition is met.

exceptions.trigger: All conditions of the statutory conditional allowance are established from original evidence.
exceptions.effect: Conditional allowance may apply; qualitative safety judgments remain unresolved.
